targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-724 competence-localization diagnostic (non_contributory, promotes/demotes nothing). Diffuse across the three OFAT factors (P1 budget A1, encoder-freeze A2, mechanism count A3, combined A4 -- all sub-floor; oracle 6.05 clears the 1.0 floor). Autopsy (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-724_2026-07-09) localizes the deficit to the ONE invariant 724 never varied: bias-head-only REINFORCE policy learning over prediction-trained representations. Routed to /queue-experiment for a policy-learning discriminator (REE full-policy-head arm + non-REE vanilla-RL control on identical observation) to resolve H1 (REE action stack) vs H2 (observation interface unlearnable) BEFORE any competence-substrate build. Brake-exempt (different question, no claim tagged).

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.rationale: Build target (policy-learning substrate vs observation encoding) is exactly what the discriminator decides; do not write a substrate entry until H1/H2 resolves.

recommended_redesign.brake_exempt_reason: different question than ARC-062/MECH-309; tags no claim; not a lettered re-test of a same-claim ceiling
recommended_redesign.env: identical to 724 (same ENV_KWARGS, seeds 42/43/44, P2 protocol); keep hand-coded oracle as positive control

non-REE vanilla learned policy (small PPO or DQN MLP) on the identical observation vector, no REE machinery, comparable budget

recommended_redesign.load_bearing_dv: P2 mean_resources_per_episode vs floor 1.0 (majority of seeds)

interpretation_grid.B2_clears_AND_B1_clears: H1 (policy-learning mechanism): bias-head-only was the bottleneck -> build proper action/policy-learning substrate under f_dominance_conversion_ceiling
interpretation_grid.B2_clears_AND_B1_fails: deeper H1: REE stack beyond the policy head obstructs even a full head -> narrow to planner/drives/gating; do not build the head alone
interpretation_grid.B2_fails: H2 (observation/env interface): target is the observation encoding, not the policy; a policy-learning build would be wasted
interpretation_grid.B1_clears_AND_B2_fails: FLAG implausible (REE full-head beating vanilla RL on identical obs); check leakage / privileged input

re_derive_brake.reason: brake-exempt: diagnostic tags no claim (claim_ids=[]); asks a different question than the ARC-062/MECH-309 conversion-ceiling claims; not a same-claim lettered re-test

learning_extracted: Competence deficit is invariant to training budget, encoder plasticity, and mechanism count (and their combination) -> lives in the shared un-varied constant: bias-head-only policy learning over prediction-only representations.
REE is prediction-rich, action-poor: substantial world model, action learned via a bias head -- a biological translation gap vs dorsal-striatal action learning.
All-ON gating does NOT suppress foraging (A3 stripped it, got worse) -- kills the 'mechanisms veto action' hypothesis for this substrate.

724's OFAT design had a blind spot: varied everything except the policy-learning mechanism, and included no learned non-REE control -- future localization diagnostics should vary the learning mechanism and include a non-REE learned control.
